title: [review] handoff.rs:257: Negative CBOR integers ca
description: replay_index is decoded via `i128::from(*i) as u64`. A negative CBOR integer (e.g., -1) produces a very large u64 (u64::MAX), corrupting the replay window state. An attacker controlling the response could set replay_index to MAX, potentially enabling replay attacks by invalidating the window.
